mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, display_name, email, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, bio = #{bio}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.avatar_url, u.created_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND f.followee_id = u.id ) AS followed_by_me FROM users u
(u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR u.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
AND (u.created_at, u.id) < (#{cursorCreatedAt}, #{cursorId})
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
